blocks.orig: Lolkisale Tarangire Camp is a serene and luxurious getaway in the Tarangire National Park. The camp has 8 custom-designed safari tents, on an elevated wooden platform. Located right by the wetlands, you see herds passing through in search of water from your private porch at the break of day. Thoughtfully selected interiors, with soft natural colours and textures, and a comfy bed give you just that extra touch of comfort you need on a safari. In the dining tent and lounge area you can enjoy great meals, great conversations, and a good nightcap from a well-stocked bar. You don’t need much more on safari in the African bush!
blocks.html: In Tarangire National Park, Lolkisale Tarangire Camp offers a calm and luxurious retreat. Its 8 custom-designed safari tents stand on a raised wooden platform. Because the camp sits right next to the wetlands, you can watch herds come by looking for water from your private porch at dawn. Carefully chosen interiors in soft natural colours and textures, plus a comfortable bed, add that bit of extra comfort you want on safari. The dining tent and lounge area are the place for good meals, good conversation and a nightcap from a well-stocked bar. On safari in the African bush, you don’t need a lot more!
